content:
**Fixed .memory/index.jsonl merge gap (#330) — union merge + negative control + repo tripwire**

**What**: Implemented issue #330 (epic #313) in worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-330, branch fix/issue-330-fixmemory-memoryindexjsonl-has-no-merge, base main. Added `/.memory/index.jsonl merge=union` to .gitattributes + brain/scripts/memory/lib/index-merge.integration.test.mjs (4 tests) + Tier-2 brain-draft for memory-format.md. Full SDD artifact set written. Gates: repo:check ✓, npm test 2036/2036 ✓, change:verify ✓.

**Why**: index.jsonl was the only committed file under .memory/ with no merge strategy, so it conflicted on every parallel branch that ran memory:share. Observed 2026-07-25 on chore/issue-325.

**Where**: .gitattributes; brain/scripts/memory/lib/index-merge.integration.test.mjs; openspec/changes/issue-330-memory-index-merge-strategy/{proposal,spec,design,tasks}.md + brain-drafts/memory-format-index-merge.md

**Learned** (non-obvious, all verified against code):
1. index.jsonl is NOT append-only like records/*.jsonl — serializeIndex (format.mjs:207-211) emits the WHOLE file sorted by id and rebuildIndex (store.mjs:91) does one writeFileSync. It is a deterministic full rewrite, so union can leave it UNSORTED, not merely duplicated. The records' rationale does not transfer unchanged.
2. NOTHING reads index.jsonl. Every indexPath site in brain/scripts/** is a write through rebuildIndex. Write-time dedup reads records/ (store.mjs:97-99 says so explicitly). So an unsorted/duplicated index breaks nothing.
3. Index self-healing is BACKEND-ASYMMETRIC: plainfiles reindexes unconditionally in share/pull/save/setup; engram's share() reindexes ONLY when it appended something (engram.mjs:315-318) and engram's pull() never reindexes at all (engram.mjs:589-619). This is the evidence for the deferred follow-up on the issue's "consider also".
4. Test-design doctrine reused: a merge-mechanism test that builds its own fixture .gitattributes stays green even if the shipped file loses the rule — exactly the M10/#335 "green in test, inert in production" class. Fix = pair it with a repo tripwire reading the real .gitattributes, plus a negative control proving the attribute is causal.
5. Doc drift found, NOT fixed (noted in the draft for human ruling): memory-format.md:112 says "The index, not the log, is the dedup authority" which reads more absolutely than store.mjs:97-99 supports; and "queries read through the index" has no implementation — plainfiles.search() scans records/ directly.
6. Tracker correction: epic #313 body names feature/v2.0.0 as integration base, but `git rev-list --left-right --count origin/feature/v2.0.0...origin/main` = "0 32" — fully absorbed. Real tracker is main. Epic body is stale and declares itself source of truth, so it needs a doc PR.
7. Repo test invocation gotcha: `node --test <dir>` fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND; the repo verb is `npm test` = `node --test "brain/scripts/**/*.test.mjs"`.

**Blocked**: #330 carries type:bug + priority:high but NOT status:approved. Invariant 1 (issue-link) fails the PR without it, and the agent must never apply that label (agent-authorities Tier 2/3, issue #124). Human signature required before push/PR.
